notes.subject: mokgwaro (מזח)
notes.rationale: Lentšu le tlwaelega hle: gare ya dithapo (YLT) goba maatla/kgoreletšo (KJV) goba boema-bakeng (BSB); ke lentšu le tlwaelega hle la Sepedi

notes.subject: Fetela
notes.rationale: Ya croix-over: etela fela go feta (KJV) goba go šoma lefase bjalo ka Yaore (JPS); phapang e sa feleng magareng a diphetholelo

notes.subject: morwadi wa Tarshishe
notes.rationale: Taetso ya go mpshafatša go bašwi ba Tarshishe ka bobedi e bitša motho wa yena

translation: Fetela lefasing la gago bjalo ka Yaore, morwadi wa Tarshishe; ga go sa na mokgwaro.
